name: Collier Elowen
ligne: Sur le collier Elowen, le carré pavé de diamants se bombe autour d’une pierre en serti clos.
description: Collier Elowen, or blanc, jaune ou rose 750/1000, serti en clos d’un diamant rond et pavé de diamants ronds. Pierre de centre aussi proposée en émeraude, rubis ou saphir.
details: Or blanc 750 ‰, Or jaune 750 ‰, Or rose 750 ‰
Serti en clos d’un diamant rond et pavé de diamants ronds

en.ligne: On the Elowen necklace, the square of pavé-set diamonds rises in a dome around a stone in a rub-over setting.
en.description: Elowen necklace in 18ct white, yellow or rose gold, set with a round diamond in a rub-over setting and pavé-set round diamonds. Centre stone also available in emerald, ruby or sapphire.

it.ligne: Nella collana Elowen il quadrato a pavé di diamanti si fa bombato attorno a una pietra a castone.
it.description: Collana Elowen in oro bianco, giallo o rosa 18 kt, con un diamante rotondo a castone e pavé di diamanti rotondi. Pietra centrale disponibile anche in smeraldo, rubino o zaffiro.
